meaning: Derive the EXACT existing SubsistentBeingIsInfiniteReading (for every x, esseOf x = essenceOf x implies Infinite x) from four typed reception readings over the same essenceOf/esseOf maps and the same primitive Infinite. Take x whose esse is its essence and suppose its esse is limited. By limitation-only-through-reception (q.7 a.1) its esse is received in some principle r; by reception-in-own-essence (De ente c.4) r is the essence of x, which equals its esse; this contradicts receiver-is-not-the-received-esse (De ente c.3). So the esse of x is not limited, and by unlimited-esse-is-infinite (q.7 a.1-2) x is infinite. No premise contains the conclusion: identity of essence and esse appears in none of them, and STMT-SUBSISTENT-INFINITY-RECEPTION-CONTROLS shows each is needed. All four premises remain open, sourced but undefended; the derivation does not establish that any of them is true, that anything's esse is its essence, or that any being is infinite.
